% Reproduces BUG-14: \input without braces (plain TeX style)
% \input xy loads the xy package (xypic); braceless form not handled by unfold.py
\documentclass{article}
\input xy
\begin{document}
% \xymatrix is defined by xy.tex loaded via plain-TeX \input above
$\xymatrix{ A \ar[r] & B }$
\end{document}
